title: Catalogue preparation, recipient corrections and complete receiving

task.name: Prepare and receive a complete customer catalogue edition
task.purpose: Give the catalogue owner, implementation engineer and recipient one commissioned workflow from complete published documents and saved review decisions to an editable, independently received catalogue project.
task.request: Select the original customer Workshare, publication source, useful catalogue output and named operator. Receive the complete original CKAN/DCAT workspace archive and inspect every retained catalogue, migration review, active and historical release, acquisition attempt, correction revision, recipient proposal, author reconciliation, semantic validation and saved-pair comparison. Explicitly include or exclude each source record with its purpose while keeping every original byte in the archive. Operate the existing catalogue application to acquire a later publication, inspect full JSON changes and record conservation, select an accepted baseline, carry selected exact identity decisions, edit typed values and arrays, issue a complete standalone recipient package, receive saved proposals and explicitly reconcile the author edition. When semantic work is included, select the retained explicit context/base/shapes profile and original native runtime, then inspect full findings, graph changes and qualified impact results. Retain original failed, interrupted and completed observations. Bind the exact complete archive and scope document to the original Installation sources and unchanged Workshare. Deliver installed source/runtime, original project, all output files, author decisions and independently reopened recipient work.
task.completeOutput: One complete source-bound catalogue project and selected useful edition, its full acquisition, review, correction and recipient history, selected semantic evidence when commissioned, exact output catalogue and complete portable archive; the same original Installation/Workshare and a named independently received working environment.
task.repeatTrigger: An actual new publication edition, changed authorised catalogue scope, recipient correction or commissioned review period starts useful following work. Recovery and replay continue their original requests.
task.pricedUnit: The actual agreed catalogue edition or complete source-review-and-receiving task. Retain its selected merchant unit, atomic task budget and separately agreed professional work phases in the original Workshare.

source.reference: The exact complete original .ckanw archive, original workspace identity and every explicitly selected record hash; the exact complete scope JSON and current original customer Workshare.
source.population: All original catalogue documents, review candidates, releases, acquisitions, correction revisions, recipient packages and decisions, semantic profiles, findings and comparison artifacts remain in the complete archive. Each record has an explicit inclusion or exclusion purpose for this commissioning.
source.meaning: Catalogue bytes and JSON numeric tokens retain their original spelling and type. RDF terms retain their original type, datatype and language. A local catalogue release is an operator selection. Native validation and graph comparison retain actual outcomes and qualified coverage or impact limits. Commercial acceptance and paid purchases use their original Installation records.
source.changePolicy: A changed source edition, exact correction revision or recipient return retains a distinct immutable identity. Review current source and active author revision before editing or adopting proposals; reconcile structural array conflicts explicitly. Keep original request identities across unknown replies and resume incomplete adoption decisions after any already-saved revision.

receiving.application: The existing DCAT catalogue application and original Grant Operations Installation/Workshare desk, supplied through the dcat-installation distribution and its maintained preparation service.
receiving.acceptanceRule: The complete original archive and exact selection JSON are native case sources before obtaining the matching fresh case and Workshare seed. Prepare, inspect and save using the original Installation writer. Receive the complete catalogue workspace through its unchanged receiver and the whole Operations case through its existing importer. Reopen original sources, full output files, selected record histories and the same original commercial phases; record actual customer observations under those phases.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: The original publisher and customer retain their source and scope authority. Operators make attributed corrections and explicit recipient reconciliation in the original application. Change commercial scope, access, terms or withdrawal through the current original Workshare/Installation and its authorised owner.
receiving.recovery: Keep exact archive/scope bytes, source attachment IDs, fresh seed and case version, original request IDs and the same preparation directory. Reopen retained preparation after a lost reply. Native receiving continues its original marker and directory. Preserve later valid recipient work; source retries never substitute a fresh unrelated project or acceptance record.
receiving.maintenance: Name the publication owner, implementation engineer, relationship owner, installed host operator and independent receiver. Supply complete source and selected runtime, original guides, private working archives, all outputs and the agreed support course. The producing operator opens and uses the actual desktop/narrow product and all outgoing attachments before presentation.

steps.title: Retain the original commission
steps.result: Open the existing customer Workshare and actual intended catalogue service. Preserve its scope, phases, effort, funding, assignments, prices and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: Install both maintained applications
steps.result: Use the original catalogue and Grant Operations source selection, configured Python/runtime and private workspaces. Record the actual installed source and host.

steps.title: Inspect the complete source archive
steps.result: Export a quiet original .ckanw edition. The existing reader verifies all members; its original receiver validates complete catalogue, review, correction, recipient and semantic histories.

steps.title: Choose the complete commissioning scope
steps.result: Inspect every source family and original file. Include or exclude each record with its actual purpose. Retain the whole source report and complete original archive regardless of scope choices.

steps.title: Attach source and scope to the actual case
steps.result: Use the native complete DCAT-source action for the .ckanw and the original ordinary source action for scope JSON. Obtain the same fresh case and Workshare seed after both source attachments.

steps.title: Prepare and save the Installation
steps.result: Use the exact source identities and actual payment, deployment and receiver selections. Preview and save through the original Installation writer with its case version, actor and stable request.

steps.title: Operate the catalogue service
steps.result: Carry out the commissioned acquisition, review, exact corrections, recipient return and optional semantic comparison through the original application. Retain complete outputs and actual original operation results.

steps.title: Record actual outcomes
steps.result: Apply the original Workshare acceptance criteria to named observations and actual received outputs. Keep catalogue decisions, engineering work, commercial acceptance and paid purchases in their original records.

steps.title: Independently receive both full workspaces
steps.result: Transfer the complete catalogue archive and complete Operations bundle. Use distinct original receiving destinations, reopen selected historical records and all source attachments, then save permitted following work.

steps.title: Use and inspect the actual customer delivery
steps.result: Open the exact desktop and narrow product, source report and meaningful controls. Open every complete attachment, original JSON/HTML package, archive content and applicable PDF page. Repair concrete defects and return actual rendered observations.

inputs: The original customer Workshare and source-backed commercial scope, current case and pinned plan.
One complete quiet original .ckanw archive and its exact SHA-256; all catalogue, correction, recipient, semantic and acquisition history remains retained.
The complete derived source report and every explicit inclusion/exclusion decision with its actual purpose.
The actual complete native case source IDs for the archive and exact scope JSON; matching fresh case and Workshare seed after attaching them.
Actual merchant/buyer deployments, original atomic payment terms and whole-task budget, separate professional phases and named receiving host/operator.
The maintained catalogue archive reader, original Operations writer/importer and the selected installed runtime. Semantic execution uses the original explicit profile and native engine.

Supported DCAT case sources are at most128MiB each and256MiB total; complete Operations bundles are at most320MiB. Ordinary attachments retain8MiB/file and24MiB aggregate;200source files maximum. Scope JSON remains within8MiB. Larger customer source selections require an explicitly supported receiving capacity; complete bytes remain authoritative.
Actual complete source files, independently received editable workspaces and producing-operator desktop/narrow and attachment observations.
